events.name: Utah Mammoth at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Sean Durzi scored 1:06 into overtime and the Utah Mammoth beat the New York Rangers 3-2 on Monday night for their second win in three games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sean Durzi scores in OT to give Mammoth 3-2 win over Rangers

headlines.description: — Justin Sourdif scored his first NHL hat trick and added two assists and the Washington Capitals beat the Anaheim Ducks 7-4 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Justin Sourdif scores his first hat trick to lead the Capitals to a 7-4 win over the Ducks

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — James van Riemsdyk had a goal and two assists to lead the Detroit Red Wings to a 5-3 win over the Ottawa Senators on Monday night to snap a two-game losing skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Wings pounce on Senators early, hold on for 5-3 win

headlines.description: — Shane Wright scored the go-ahead goal early in the third period and Philipp Grubauer made 41 saves to lead the streaking Seattle Kraken past the Calgary Flames 5-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red-hot Grubauer backstops streaking Kraken to 5-1 win over Flames

events.name: Minnesota Wild at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Andrei Kuzmenko had a goal and an assist, and the Los Angeles Kings held on to beat the Minnesota Wild 4-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kuzmenko has goal and assist as Kings beat Wild 4-2
